pr_title: fix(core): attempt to recover from user errors during creation
pr_body:
If there's an error during the first creation pass of a `TView`, the data structure may be corrupted which will cause framework assertion failures downstream which can mask the user's error. These changes add a new flag to the `TView` that indicates whether the first creation pass was successful, and if it wasn't try re-create the `TView`.

Fixes #31221.

It looks like `ASSERTION ERROR: Reached the max number of directives` error appears because there is some other error (most likely a fatal one) that happened in the app at creation time, but was caught by the error handling logic (presumably in Router). We will look into this more and try to handle this case better and surface relevant error.

As a temporary workaround, please try to find the original error by pausing on all exceptions in browser dev tools, for example [as described here](https://developers.google.com/web/updates/2015/05/automatically-pause-on-any-exception).
